headline: Full school day cellphone bans are more popular than ever
summary: Support for cellphone bans in schools is growing nationwide. 77% of US adults back bans in classes; 48% support full-day bans. This marks the first time full-day ban support has reached this level.

headline: The Ferrari Luce has at least 500 fans
summary: Ferrari's Luce EV has already hit its 2026 sales target. The Jony Ive-designed EV aimed for just under 500 units this year. This milestone was reached only two months post-launch.

headline: Remarkable’s refurbished bundle is an awesome deal that’s over $350 off
summary: Remarkable Paper Pro refurbished bundle is on sale for $449.99. This deal offers a significant discount of over $350 from its original price. The offer at Woot is available until July 31st.

headline: DoorDash is going airborne with new drone delivery division
summary: DoorDash is launching "DoorDash Air" for drone deliveries. The company received FAA approval with a Part 135 air carrier certification. This clears the path for drone food delivery in the near future.

headline: ‘I Have a Personal Vendetta Against Filler Content’ – How The Blood of Dawnwalker Makes Its Open World Feel Meaningful
summary: Rebel Wolves aims to create a meaningful open world in 'The Blood of Dawnwalker'. The game rejects "filler content" through deep lore and activity design. Developers detail their approach to immersive world-building.

headline: Tony Review
summary: "Tony" is a new review focusing on Anthony Bourdain's teenage years. Matt Johnson directs the film. The review offers insights into a specific chapter of Bourdain's life.

headline: LEGO's Batman Forever Batmobile Set Has Received a Sizable $25 Discount at Amazon
summary: LEGO Batman Forever Batmobile set is currently $74.99 on Amazon. This represents a $25 discount from its original $99.99 price. The sale price is close to the lowest ever for the set.

headline: Halo: Campaign Evolved Is Now Out for PS5 and Xbox – Here’s What Comes in Each Edition
summary: Halo: Campaign Evolved has launched for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X. The article details available editions and their contents. Players can now explore the evolved campaign on new-gen consoles.

headline: More than half of England in drought, Environment Agency declares
summary: Over half of England is officially declared to be in a drought. This follows an exceptionally hot and dry period. Rivers, crops, and nature have been severely impacted.

headline: Burnham doesn't rule out tax rises to fix social care
summary: Burnham is considering tax rises to address social care funding. The Prime Minister is holding cross-party talks on social care reform. A review of England's social care system is being fast-tracked.

headline: Moment police officers set foot in 'horror scene' funeral home
summary: Police entered a Hull funeral home described as a "horror scene." Officers found messy side rooms strewn with rubbish at Legacy funeral home. The discovery raised concerns about the premises.

headline: Four women accuse Jared Leto of criminal sexual conduct when they were teenagers
summary: Four women accuse Jared Leto of criminal sexual conduct during their teenage years. In total, 10 women have made allegations of mistreatment against him. The actor and musician faces multiple accusations.
